issue.title: Maestro smoke: Record happy path (mic, capture, playback)
issue.body:
## Summary / context

Parent: #488.

Automate the Record tab happy path that QA currently runs by hand: mic allow → record → stop → play take.

## Current vs expected

**Current:** Strong Record `testID`s (`record-start-button`, `record-stop-button`, take lists, etc.). Manual nightly only.

**Expected:** Maestro flow exercising capture + playback on a seeded verse assignment. Avoid destructive stage-advance / send unless safe for shared **dev** data.

## Scope

**In scope**
- Grant mic on `launchApp` / first prompt
- Navigate to Record on an assigned verse
- Start → stop recording
- Assert take appears; play/pause take
- Document residual gaps (stage advance, conflict warnings, source-audio dock) if not automated

**Out of scope**
- Full upload-to-server proof (may pair lightly with Sync child)
- All-takes vs mine edge matrix
- Stage advance Send if it mutates shared project state unsafely

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Happy-path flow green on emulator with mic permission
- [ ] Mic-deny path deferred to edge ticket (or linked)
- [ ] No silent data destruction of other users’ work
- [ ] Flaky timing (waveform / duration) handled with explicit waits

## Verification / test plan

1. Dedicated Maestro user + assigned chapter
2. Run record smoke
3. Confirm take playable; optionally leave take local-only

## Links

- Refs #488
- `RecordTab.tsx`, `docs/features/record-tab/`
